issues.message: sound 没有词尾不发音的 e；sounding 应直接加 -ing。
遗漏了常规比较级 sounder 和最高级 soundest；不能只把 more sound、most sound 教作通常形式。
遗漏常见副词用法 sound asleep，以及形容词的酣睡、知识扎实、财务稳健义和短语动词 sound someone out。已分别补充用法及每义两个例句，并补入 safe and sound。
声音义缺少常见的设备音频和语音场景；发声义尚未说明通过言语发出警告的 sound a warning。已补充对应例句和搭配。
hearing and sense of sound 重复且不自然，sound and hearing 也不是支持该解释的惯常搭配。来源虽收录少见的听觉义，日常听觉、听力仍通常用 hearing；已改教词条中的听觉范围用法 within sound of。
地理义被过度限定为连接较大水域的海峡；sound 也可指海湾或海汊。
stages 按中古英语至拉丁语排列，会画成与历史发展相反的箭头；另外两条独立来源已有可靠材料却未具体说明。已纠正顺序，并在 summary 分别补入海峡义与形容词义的来源。
已检索来源明确收录逻辑学术语义，宜与普通的“合理、可靠”区分：sound argument 要求推理有效且前提全真。
Cambridge 正文未取得，不能作为本次已读取的支持材料。已删除该来源记录及关联，能够由已取得的维基词典英语词条支持的内容改引该来源，其余保留为专业语言知识判断。

review.coverageAssessment: 已核对原词条全部名词、动词、形容词及副词释义。修订后覆盖常见声音、语音和设备音频、听起来、发声与警告、合理可靠、健康与结构完好、酣睡、扎实知识、财务稳健及 sound out；新增核心义均有两个原创英中例句。听觉范围、地理、测深及逻辑术语放在拓展部分。医学探条和听诊等专业义，以及罕见的 sound 指听觉用法，不作为初中核心展开。历史词源仅采用已取得的法语维基词典英语词条，未将法语释义误当成词的语言；未取得的 Cambridge 正文不作证据。

已取得来源收录此少见用法；不作为可自由替换 hearing 的初中生产性用法，删除原稿牵强的测试例句。
改用较书面的 within sound of，并明确日常听觉、听力通常用 hearing。
医学专门义，不属初中核心，本课不展开。
修正过窄定义，保留地理拓展例句。

已有准确的航海拓展例句，不列为初中核心。

医学专门义，不属初中核心，本课不展开。

senseInventory.sense: adj. 可靠的；合理的；有根据的
senseInventory.assessment: 已有两个例句和限定语境的近义、反向表达；sounds sound 语法成立，保留。

补入最实用的 sound asleep，说明搭配限制，并以词族 soundly 对照 sleep soundly。

{"id":"sound-adj-sleep","title":"熟的；安稳的（指睡眠）","meaning":"形容睡眠深而安稳，不容易被打扰。","usageNote":"常放在 sleep 前，如 a sound sleep、a sound night's sleep。这里 sound 是形容词；be sound asleep 中的 sound 则是副词。","examples":[{"id":"sound-adj-sleep-ex1","senseId":"sound-adj-sleep","en":"I had a sound night's sleep after the long walk.","zh":"长途步行后，我一夜睡得很香。","note":"a sound night's sleep 指一夜安稳的睡眠。"},{"id":"sound-adj-sleep-ex2","senseId":"sound-adj-sleep","en":"The baby fell into a sound sleep after her feed.","zh":"宝宝吃完奶后沉沉地睡着了。","note":"a sound sleep 指睡得深而安稳的一觉。"}],"patterns":[{"en":"have a sound night's sleep","zh":"一夜睡得很安稳","note":"sound 修饰睡眠，night's 带所有格符号。","kind":"sentence-pattern"}],"collocations":[{"en":"a sound sleep","zh":"酣睡；安稳的一觉","note":"sound 是形容词，修饰名词 sleep。","kind":"common-collocation"}],"relatedExpressions":{"similar":[{"en":"deep sleep","zh":"深沉的睡眠","note":"日常语境中与 sound sleep 接近；在睡眠科学中 deep sleep 还可能指特定睡眠阶段。"}],"contrasting":[{"en":"light sleep","zh":"浅睡","note":"强调容易被声音或动静惊醒，与睡得很沉形成对照。"}],"similarNote":"日常谈睡得沉可用 sound sleep 或 deep sleep。","contrastingNote":"light sleep 对照的是睡眠深浅，不对应 sound 的可靠或健康等义。"},"sourceIds":[]}

{"id":"sound-adv-asleep","title":"完全地；充分地（常见于 sound asleep）","meaning":"副词 sound 表示程度充分；常用短语 sound asleep 整体表示睡得很熟。","usageNote":"这一副词用法的搭配范围很窄，主要记 be sound asleep。修饰动词 sleep 时，通常用派生副词 soundly，如 sleep soundly。","examples":[{"id":"sound-adv-asleep-ex1","senseId":"sound-adv-asleep","en":"The baby was sound asleep when we got home.","zh":"我们到家时，宝宝已经睡熟了。","note":"sound 修饰形容词 asleep，表示熟睡。"},{"id":"sound-adv-asleep-ex2","senseId":"sound-adv-asleep","en":"By ten o'clock, both children were sound asleep.","zh":"到十点钟时，两个孩子都已经睡熟了。","note":"be sound asleep 描写处于熟睡状态。"}],"patterns":[{"en":"be sound asleep","zh":"睡得很熟","note":"asleep 是形容词，sound 在这里作副词加强程度。","kind":"sentence-pattern"}],"collocations":[{"en":"sound asleep","zh":"熟睡的；睡得很熟","note":"按整个短语理解，不把这个副词 sound 任意套用于其他形容词。","kind":"fixed-expression"}],"relatedExpressions":{"similar":[{"en":"fast asleep","zh":"熟睡的","note":"与 sound asleep 很接近；这里 fast 表示睡得熟，不是速度快。"}],"contrasting":[{"en":"wide awake","zh":"完全清醒的","note":"与熟睡状态相对，wide 在这里修饰 awake。"}],"similarNote":"sound asleep 和 fast asleep 都是常用的熟睡表达。","contrastingNote":"wide awake 对照的是睡眠与清醒的状态。"},"sourceIds":[]}

{"id":"sound-adj-thorough","title":"扎实的；充分的（知识、理解等）","meaning":"形容知识、理解或基础扎实可靠，足以支持实际运用。","usageNote":"常见 a sound knowledge of...、a sound understanding of...。knowledge 通常不可数，但 a sound knowledge of... 是惯常表达。","examples":[{"id":"sound-adj-thorough-ex1","senseId":"sound-adj-thorough","en":"This job requires a sound knowledge of English.","zh":"这份工作要求具备扎实的英语知识。","note":"a sound knowledge of 表示对某方面的知识掌握扎实。"},{"id":"sound-adj-thorough-ex2","senseId":"sound-adj-thorough","en":"The mechanic has a sound understanding of how car engines work.","zh":"这位修车师傅对汽车发动机的工作原理掌握得很扎实。","note":"sound 修饰 understanding，强调理解可靠、有基础。"}],"patterns":[{"en":"a sound knowledge/understanding of + 名词或从句","zh":"对……有扎实的知识／理解","note":"of 后说明知识或理解涉及的内容。","kind":"sentence-pattern"}],"collocations":[{"en":"a sound knowledge of English","zh":"扎实的英语知识","note":"这里 a 与带修饰语的 knowledge 搭配。","kind":"common-collocation"}],"relatedExpressions":{"similar":[{"en":"solid","zh":"扎实的","note":"修饰 knowledge、understanding 或 foundation 时，与 sound 接近。"},{"en":"thorough","zh":"全面细致的；透彻的","note":"更强调覆盖细节；sound 更强调基础扎实、可靠。"}],"contrasting":[{"en":"superficial","zh":"肤浅的；表面的","note":"修饰 knowledge 或 understanding 时，与理解扎实形成对照。"}],"similarNote":"sound 与 solid 都可强调知识扎实；thorough 更着重详尽和细致。","contrastingNote":"这里的对照只针对知识或理解的深浅。"},"sourceIds":[]}

{"id":"sound-adj-financial","title":"财务稳健的；资金状况良好的","meaning":"指个人、机构或企业的财务状况稳定，没有明显的资金或偿付问题。","usageNote":"常说 financially sound、a sound financial position，重点是财务基础稳健，而非单纯钱多。","examples":[{"id":"sound-adj-financial-ex1","senseId":"sound-adj-financial","en":"They checked that the bank was financially sound before opening an account.","zh":"他们在开户前确认了这家银行财务稳健。","note":"financially 是副词，修饰形容词 sound。"},{"id":"sound-adj-financial-ex2","senseId":"sound-adj-financial","en":"Even after paying for the repairs, the family was still in a sound financial position.","zh":"付完维修费后，这家人的财务状况仍然很稳健。","note":"a sound financial position 指稳定可靠的财务状况。"}],"patterns":[{"en":"be financially sound","zh":"财务稳健","note":"sound 作表语，financially 限定为财务方面。","kind":"sentence-pattern"}],"collocations":[{"en":"a sound financial position","zh":"稳健的财务状况","note":"可用于个人、家庭、公司或机构。","kind":"common-collocation"}],"relatedExpressions":{"similar":[{"en":"financially stable","zh":"财务稳定的","note":"与 financially sound 接近，强调财务状况稳定。"},{"en":"solvent","zh":"有偿付能力的","note":"重点是有能力偿还债务；sound 的财务评价范围更广。"}],"contrasting":[{"en":"financially unsound","zh":"财务不稳健的","note":"unsound 对应这一语境中的 sound，强调财务基础存在问题。"},{"en":"insolvent","zh":"无力偿债的","note":"比一般的财务不稳健更具体，不能把所有 unsound 都理解为 insolvent。"}],"similarNote":"financially stable 强调整体稳定，solvent 特别强调偿付能力。","contrastingNote":"financially unsound 是相关否定表达；insolvent 只用于偿债能力这一具体方面。"},"sourceIds":[]}

{"id":"sound-v-out","title":"试探；探询意见（sound someone out）","meaning":"通过交谈探询某人的想法、意向或态度，常用于正式提出计划之前。","usageNote":"常用 sound someone out about/on something。名词宾语可放在 out 前或后；代词必须放中间，如 sound her out。","examples":[{"id":"sound-v-out-ex1","senseId":"sound-v-out","en":"I'll sound my parents out about the trip before I book anything.","zh":"在做任何预订之前，我会先探探父母对这次旅行的态度。","note":"先探询态度，再决定是否预订。"},{"id":"sound-v-out-ex2","senseId":"sound-v-out","en":"She sounded me out on the idea of sharing a flat.","zh":"她试探了我对合租公寓这个想法的态度。","note":"代词 me 放在 sounded 和 out 之间。"}],"patterns":[{"en":"sound someone out about/on something","zh":"探询某人对某事的意见或态度","note":"这一试探义通常以带 out 的短语动词出现。","kind":"sentence-pattern"}],"collocations":[{"en":"sound out a colleague","zh":"探询同事的意见","note":"也可说 sound a colleague out。","kind":"common-collocation"}],"relatedExpressions":{"similar":[{"en":"ask for someone's opinion","zh":"征求某人的意见","note":"可直接询问；sound someone out 更强调先摸清态度。"},{"en":"feel someone out","zh":"试探某人的想法","note":"较口语化，尤其常见于美式英语，与 sound someone out 接近。"}],"contrasting":[],"similarNote":"sound someone out 常带先探询、再作决定的意味。","contrastingNote":"这一短语没有适用于各场景的固定反义词。"},"sourceIds":[]}

patches.expectedValueJson: "sound 的名词“声音”和形容词“健康、可靠”有不同的历史来源；“海峡”义也属于另一条来源，不能把这些义串成一条词源链。名词“声音”一支经中古英语 sownde，来自盎格鲁诺曼语 soun，并与拉丁语 sonus（声音、声响）相关。"
patches.valueJson: "sound 的“声音”“海峡”和形容词“健康、健全”三组意思各有不同来源。“声音”一支由拉丁语 sonus（声音、声响）经盎格鲁诺曼语 soun 进入中古英语；sownde 是 15 世纪由 sowne 改变而来的形式。“海峡”一支来自古英语 sund，上溯至原始日耳曼语 *sundą，与“游泳穿越”有关。形容词“健康、健全”来自古英语 sund，上溯至原始日耳曼语 *(ga)sundaz（健康的），与德语 gesund（健康的）同源。两个古英语 sund 字形相同，却属于不同来源。"
